title: Amber Glass Fragrance Bottle with Olive Branch
summary: A warm-lit product still life of an amber glass perfume bottle on a porous stone block, with an olive branch and a blank folded card, against a textured plaster wall.
mainPrompt: A photograph, vertical product still life, warm directional sunlight. In the left-center, standing on a pale pitted stone block, is a single squat rounded-trapezoid perfume bottle of glossy translucent amber-brown glass, its shoulders wide and its sides tapering gently to a flat base; it is topped by a flattened oval dome cap in matte pale-grey stone-like material. A single olive branch with narrow silvery-green leaves lies along the right side of the stone ledge, entering from behind the bottle and trailing to the right frame edge. In the lower-right foreground a blank folded cream paper card rests tent-like on the stone, blank with no text. Behind, filling the frame, is a mottled grey-beige plaster wall. A soft-edged diagonal band of warm light falls across the upper-left wall and the top of the bottle, while the right side of the wall sits in soft shadow; the bottle casts an amber-tinted caustic glow onto the stone at its right. Eye-level camera slightly above the ledge, medium close-up, foreground tack-sharp with the wall gently out of focus. Warm neutral beige palette with amber and muted olive-green accents, low saturation, soft contrast, fine photographic grain, no golden cast on the grey wall.
